"""
Flanged bushing / adapter sleeve — reconstructed from drawing BRAVO-8467
(ISO 2768-m general tolerances)

Geometry:
  * Main cylindrical body : Ø38.4 x 58.7 long
  * Flange at right end   : Ø45.3 x 21.3 long
  * Through bore          : Ø28.4
  * Flange free end       : 45° chamfer so the flat end face is Ø38.4
  * Left end edges        : 2 x R2.1 rounds (outer edge and bore edge)
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Parametric dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
main_od      = 38.4    # Ø38.4  - main body outside diameter
main_len     = 58.7    # 58.7   - main body length
flange_od    = 45.3    # Ø45.3  - flange outside diameter
flange_len   = 21.3    # 21.3   - flange length
end_face_dia = 38.4    # Ø38.4  - diameter of the chamfered flange end face
bore_dia     = 28.4    # Ø28.4  - through bore (from hidden lines / ISO view)
left_round   = 2.1     # 2x R2.1 - rounds on the left end edges

overall_len  = main_len + flange_len
end_chamfer  = (flange_od - end_face_dia) / 2.0   # 3.45 mm leg at 45°

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
with BuildPart() as bushing:
    # ---- main body (Ø38.4 x 58.7) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(radius=main_od / 2)
    extrude(amount=main_len)

    # ---- flange (Ø45.3 x 21.3) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(main_len)):
        Circle(radius=flange_od / 2)
    extrude(amount=flange_len)

    # ---- through bore ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(radius=bore_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=overall_len, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- 45° chamfer on the flange's outer edge at the free (right) end ----
    right_outer_edge = (
        bushing.edges()
        .filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
        .filter_by(lambda e: abs(e.radius - flange_od / 2) < 1e-6)
        .group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    )
    chamfer(right_outer_edge, length=end_chamfer)

    # ---- 2 x R2.1 rounds on the left end (outer edge + bore edge) ----
    left_end_edges = (
        bushing.edges()
        .filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
        .group_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    )
    fillet(left_end_edges, radius=left_round)

part = bushing.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
ORION-2686  -  L-shaped slotted bracket
Reconstructed from multi-view drawing (ISO 2768-m, 1:1)

Vertical plate : 80 x 68.6 x 11.4, 2 x R6.9 on the right corners,
                 front face recessed 4.6 deep leaving an 11.4 wide land,
                 four 5.7 x 45.7 x 4.6 deep pockets.
Horizontal leg : 68.6 long x 11.4 thick, flush with front face / right edge.
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
#  Key dimensions (mm)                                                #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
plate_w  = 80.0          # vertical plate width          (X)
plate_h  = 68.6          # vertical plate height         (Z)
plate_t  = 11.4          # vertical plate thickness      (Y)

leg_len  = 68.6          # horizontal leg length         (Y)
leg_t    = 11.4          # horizontal leg thickness      (Z)

corner_r = 6.9           # 2 x R6.9

land_w   = 11.4          # un-recessed land on left of front face (X)
recess_d = 4.6           # depth of the front face recess (Y)

slot_w   = 45.7          # pocket width                  (X)
slot_h   = 5.7           # pocket height                 (Z)
slot_d   = 4.6           # pocket depth (from recess floor) (Y)
slot_zc  = [14.3, 25.7, 42.9, 54.3]   # pocket centre heights (Z)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
#  Build                                                              #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
with BuildPart() as bracket:

    # ---- vertical plate, 2 x R6.9 on the right hand corners ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as profile:
        with Locations((plate_w / 2, plate_h / 2)):
            Rectangle(plate_w, plate_h)
        fillet(profile.vertices().group_by(Axis.X)[-1], radius=corner_r)
    extrude(amount=-plate_t)                       # y : 0 -> 11.4

    # ---- recess across the front face (leaves the 11.4 land) ----
    with Locations((land_w, 0, 0)):
        Box(plate_w - land_w, recess_d, plate_h,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- four pockets ----
    for zc in slot_zc:
        with Locations((land_w, recess_d, zc)):
            Box(slot_w, slot_d, slot_h,
                align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.CENTER), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- horizontal leg (flush with front face and right edge) ----
    with Locations((land_w, 0, 0)):
        Box(plate_w - land_w, leg_len, leg_t,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

    # ---- R6.9 on the front-right corner of the leg ----
    leg_corner = bracket.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).filter_by(
        lambda e: abs(e.center().X - plate_w) < 1e-6 and abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6)
    fillet(leg_corner, radius=corner_r)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
#  Export                                                             #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
export_step(bracket.part, "output.step")

"""
Reconstruction of part FALCON-6630 (P. DUBOIS) from the multi-view drawing.

Geometry interpretation
-----------------------
* Back plate             : 40.0 wide x 72.7 tall x 10.9 thick
* Top boss (back side)   : 14.6 deep  -> 10.9 + 14.6 = 25.5 total depth at the top
* Four arms              : 32.7 wide x 10.9 thick x 40.0 long, vertical pitch 18.2
                           (10.9 arm + 7.3 gap), top margin 7.3
* Two webs              : close the front end of each pair of arms (7.3 x 7.3)
* Through hole          : dia 3.6 in the plate
* Overall depth         : 14.6 + 10.9 + 40.0 = 65.5
"""

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
PLATE_W = 40.0          # back plate width              (front view, bottom dim)
PLATE_H = 72.7          # back plate height             (front view, right dim)
PLATE_T = 10.9          # back plate thickness          (detail A)

BOSS_D = 14.6           # top boss depth  -> 10.9 + 14.6 = 25.5
BOSS_H = 7.3            # top boss height

ARM_W = 32.7            # arm width                     (front view, top dim)
ARM_T = 10.9            # arm thickness (height)
ARM_L = 40.0            # arm length from the plate front face
PITCH = 18.2            # vertical pitch between arms   (side view, 18.2 / 18.2)
GAP = PITCH - ARM_T     # 7.3 free gap between the arms of a clip
TOP_MARGIN = 7.3        # plate top edge -> first arm top

WEB_T = 7.3             # web depth  (closes the arm tips)
WEB_H = GAP             # web height (spans the gap between two arms)

HOLE_D = 3.6            # through hole diameter
HOLE_Z = PLATE_H / 2 - 3.7   # hole height (mid height of the plate)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Back plate : back face at y = -PLATE_T, front face at y = 0
part = Pos(0, -PLATE_T / 2, PLATE_H / 2) * Box(PLATE_W, PLATE_T, PLATE_H)

# Top boss on the back side, flush with the top edge
part += Pos(0, -(PLATE_T + BOSS_D / 2), PLATE_H - BOSS_H / 2) * Box(PLATE_W, BOSS_D, BOSS_H)

# Four arms (two clips of two arms), measured from the top of the plate
arm_tops = [TOP_MARGIN + i * PITCH for i in range(4)]      # 7.3, 25.5, 43.7, 61.9
for z_top in arm_tops:
    z_center = PLATE_H - z_top - ARM_T / 2
    part += Pos(0, ARM_L / 2, z_center) * Box(ARM_W, ARM_L, ARM_T)

# Web closing the outer end of each clip (between arm 1-2 and arm 3-4)
for z_top in (arm_tops[0] + ARM_T, arm_tops[2] + ARM_T):   # 18.2 and 54.6 from top
    z_center = PLATE_H - z_top - WEB_H / 2
    part += Pos(0, ARM_L - WEB_T / 2, z_center) * Box(ARM_W, WEB_T, WEB_H)

# dia 3.6 through hole in the plate (along Y)
part -= Pos(0, -PLATE_T / 2, HOLE_Z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(HOLE_D / 2, PLATE_T * 4)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Reconstruction of RAVEN-3751 (S. VOLKOV / draftwright)

Interpretation of the drawing:
  * Cubic block 44.4 x 44.4 x 44.4 (front view is the 44.4 square face).
  * 4x C4.4 chamfers on the four vertical (Z) corner edges
    (seen as the corner cuts in the plan view and the inset lines
    in the front view).
  * Cylindrical boss O17.8 protruding 35.6 from the back face,
    coaxial with the depth direction, centred on the face.
  * Overall length = 44.4 (block) + 35.6 (boss) = 80.
"""

from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions (mm) ----------------
block_size   = 44.4    # cube edge (width / depth / height)
boss_dia     = 17.8    # boss diameter (O17.8)
boss_len     = 35.6    # boss protrusion beyond the back face
chamfer_size = 4.4     # 4x C4.4 corner chamfers (vertical edges)
overall_len  = 80.0    # overall length = block_size + boss_len

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # Cubic block, centred on the origin
    Box(block_size, block_size, block_size)

    # 4x C4.4 chamfers on the vertical corner edges
    chamfer(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), length=chamfer_size)

    # Cylindrical boss on the +Y (back) face, axis along Y
    with Locations((0, block_size / 2 + boss_len / 2, 0)):
        Cylinder(boss_dia / 2, boss_len, rotation=(90, 0, 0))

# ---------------- sanity check / export ----------------
solid = part.part
bb = solid.bounding_box()
print(f"Overall size : {bb.size.X:.2f} x {bb.size.Y:.2f} x {bb.size.Z:.2f} mm")
print(f"Expected     : {block_size:.2f} x {overall_len:.2f} x {block_size:.2f} mm")
assert abs(bb.size.Y - overall_len) < 1e-6, "overall length must be 80"

export_step(solid, "output.step")

"""
Reconstruction of part URSA-6868 (draftwright exercise).

The part is a constant-thickness plate: the front-view profile is extruded
through the depth given by the top view.

Overall size:  80.0 wide  x  42.9 tall  x  34.8 deep
"""
import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ key dims
W      = 80.0      # overall width  (X)  - front view
H      = 42.9      # overall height (Y)  - front view / side view
DEPTH  = 34.8      # extrusion depth (Z) - top view

R_BIG  = 56.2      # large convex radius, right hand side
R_TOP  = 6.7       # top right corner radius
R_BOT  = 2.7       # bottom right corner radius
R_FIL  = 16.1      # concave fillet between top face and vertical step
R_TAB  = 5.4       # tab corner radii  (2x)

# feature positions scaled from the drawing
X_STEP = 21.6      # x of the vertical step face (below the R16.1 fillet)
Y_TAB  = 20.2      # height of the horizontal tab face
Y_C    = 21.0      # height of the centre of the R56.2 arc

# ------------------------------------------------------- derived geometry
XC     = W - R_BIG                       # 23.8 : big arc centre x
C_BIG  = (XC, Y_C)                       # big arc centre
C_TOP  = (XC + math.sqrt((R_BIG - R_TOP) ** 2 - (H - R_TOP - Y_C) ** 2),
          H - R_TOP)                     # R6.7 corner centre
C_BOT  = (XC + math.sqrt((R_BIG - R_BOT) ** 2 - (R_BOT - Y_C) ** 2),
          R_BOT)                         # R2.7 corner centre
C_FIL  = (X_STEP + R_FIL, H - R_FIL)     # R16.1 fillet centre
C_TAB  = (R_TAB, Y_TAB - R_TAB)          # tab top-left corner centre
C_BL   = (R_TAB, R_TAB)                  # bottom-left corner centre


def pt_on_line(p_from, p_to, dist):
    """point at 'dist' from p_from along the line p_from -> p_to"""
    vx, vy = p_to[0] - p_from[0], p_to[1] - p_from[1]
    L = math.hypot(vx, vy)
    return (p_from[0] + vx / L * dist, p_from[1] + vy / L * dist)


def ang(c, p):
    """angle (deg) of point p as seen from centre c"""
    return math.degrees(math.atan2(p[1] - c[1], p[0] - c[0]))


# tangency points of the big arc with the two corner rounds
T_BOT = pt_on_line(C_BIG, C_BOT, R_BIG)   # big arc <-> R2.7
T_TOP = pt_on_line(C_BIG, C_TOP, R_BIG)   # big arc <-> R6.7

# --------------------------------------------------------------- modelling
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            # bottom edge
            Line((R_TAB, 0), (C_BOT[0], 0))
            # R2.7 bottom-right corner
            CenterArc(C_BOT, R_BOT,
                      ang(C_BOT, (C_BOT[0], 0)),
                      ang(C_BOT, T_BOT) - ang(C_BOT, (C_BOT[0], 0)))
            # R56.2 large convex arc (right side)
            CenterArc(C_BIG, R_BIG,
                      ang(C_BIG, T_BOT),
                      ang(C_BIG, T_TOP) - ang(C_BIG, T_BOT))
            # R6.7 top-right corner
            CenterArc(C_TOP, R_TOP,
                      ang(C_TOP, T_TOP),
                      ang(C_TOP, (C_TOP[0], H)) - ang(C_TOP, T_TOP))
            # top edge
            Line((C_TOP[0], H), (C_FIL[0], H))
            # R16.1 concave fillet, top edge -> vertical step
            CenterArc(C_FIL, R_FIL, 90, 90)
            # vertical step face
            Line((X_STEP, H - R_FIL), (X_STEP, Y_TAB))
            # tab top face
            Line((X_STEP, Y_TAB), (R_TAB, Y_TAB))
            # R5.4 tab top-left corner
            CenterArc(C_TAB, R_TAB, 90, 90)
            # left edge
            Line((0, Y_TAB - R_TAB), (0, R_TAB))
            # R5.4 bottom-left corner
            CenterArc(C_BL, R_TAB, 180, 90)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=DEPTH)

part = bp.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ export
export_step(part, "output.step")

print(f"bounding box : {part.bounding_box().size}")
print(f"volume       : {part.volume:.1f} mm^3")

"""Reconstruction of bracket ORION-3896 from multi-view drawing.

Coordinate system:
    X = 80 mm overall length  (front view width)
    Y = 60 mm overall depth   (top view / side view length)
    Z = 32 mm overall height  (side view height)
"""
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions taken from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
length = 80.0          # overall length in X
depth = 60.0           # overall depth in Y
height = 32.0          # overall height in Z

base_height = 12.0     # height of material below the U-slot
slot_depth = height - base_height      # 20 (slot depth from top)
slot_width = 20.0      # width of the U-slot
prong_width = 15.0     # width of each prong (left/right of slot)

end_radius = 16.0                        # rounded (full-round) right end
end_center_y = depth - end_radius        # 44 -> semicircle centre in Y

hole_dia = 10.0                          # 4x Ø10 THRU + Ø10 THRU cross hole
hole_r = hole_dia / 2.0

# 4 vertical holes: 8 mm from the left/right ends, 20 mm from front/back faces
hole_xs = (8.0, length - 8.0)            # 8 and 72
hole_ys = (20.0, depth - 20.0)           # 20 and 40

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Base body: rectangular block + full-round (semicircular) right end
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
body = Box(length, end_center_y, height,
           align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))

round_end = Cylinder(end_radius, length, rotation=(0, 90, 0))   # axis along X
round_end = Pos(length / 2, end_center_y, height / 2) * round_end

part = body + round_end

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) U-slot cut from the top (full depth), 20 wide, 20 deep, centred
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
slot_x0 = (length - slot_width) / 2.0    # 30
slot = Box(slot_width, depth + 2.0, slot_depth + 1.0,
           align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
slot = Pos(slot_x0, -1.0, base_height) * slot
part -= slot

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Four Ø10 THRU vertical holes (2 x 2 pattern)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for hx in hole_xs:
    for hy in hole_ys:
        hole = Cylinder(hole_r, height + 2.0,
                        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        part -= Pos(hx, hy, -1.0) * hole

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Ø10 THRU cross hole through the rounded end (axis along X)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cross_hole = Cylinder(hole_r, length + 2.0, rotation=(0, 90, 0))
cross_hole = Pos(length / 2, end_center_y, height / 2) * cross_hole
part -= cross_hole

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Hex-head boss with cylindrical shank and central through hole.
Reconstructed from drawing DELTA-2276 (ISO 2768-m, scale 1:1).

Dimensions taken from the drawing (mm):
    overall length      80.0
    shank length        61.5
    head thickness      18.5   (= 80.0 - 61.5)
    hex across corners  61.5
    hex across flats    53.3   (= 2/sqrt(3) * 61.5)
    shank diameter      53.3   (cylinder inscribed in the hexagon)
    through hole dia    34.8
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key (parametric) dimensions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_length = 80.0      # total length of the part
shank_length   = 61.5      # length of the cylindrical shank
head_thickness = overall_length - shank_length   # 18.5
across_corners = 61.5      # hexagon corner-to-corner
across_flats   = 53.3      # hexagon flat-to-flat
shank_dia      = 53.3      # shank cylinder diameter
hole_dia       = 34.8      # central through hole diameter

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hexagonal head - regular hexagon, vertex up (flats left/right),
# extruded by the head thickness
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
R = across_corners / 2.0
hex_pts = [
    (R * math.cos(math.radians(90.0 + i * 60.0)),
     R * math.sin(math.radians(90.0 + i * 60.0)))
    for i in range(6)
]
head = extrude(Polygon(*hex_pts, align=None), amount=head_thickness)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cylindrical shank - coaxial, starting at the head's back face
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
shank = Pos(0, 0, head_thickness) * Cylinder(
    shank_dia / 2.0,
    shank_length,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Central through hole - drilled through the whole part
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hole = Pos(0, 0, -1.0) * Cylinder(
    hole_dia / 2.0,
    overall_length + 2.0,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine and export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part = head + shank - hole
part.label = "DELTA-2276 hex-head boss"

export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Fork / clevis pin  -  drawing HELIOS-4437 (ISO 2768-m)
Reconstructed from the front view, left end view, DETAIL A and the isometric.

     |<-- 4.1 -->|<------- 63.4 ------->|<-- 12.5 -->|<- 8 ->|
     |  ø2.8     |        ø8.3          |   ø16.6    | ø16.6 |
     |<--------------------- 80 -------------------->|
     C0.3                                                  slot + ø2.8 cross hole

All dimensions in millimetres.
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
#  key (parametric) dimensions                                       #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
tip_dia       = 2.8        # ø2.8  pilot pin
tip_len       = 4.1        # 4.1   pilot pin length
tip_chamfer   = 0.3        # C0.3  chamfer on the free end

shank_dia     = 8.3        # ø8.3  shank
shank_len     = 63.4       # 63.4  shank length

collar_dia    = 16.6       # ø16.6 collar / flange
collar_len    = 12.5       # 67.5 -> 80.0  (so that tip+shank+collar = 80)
groove_dia    = 13.0       # relief groove in the collar
groove_width  = 3.0
groove_offset = 2.0        # groove front edge from collar front face

head_dia      = 16.6       # ø16.6 forked head (16.6 across, end view)
head_len      = 8.0        # 80.0 -> 88.0
slot_width    = 4.0        # through slot between the two prongs
slot_depth    = 8.5        # straight part of the slot, from the free end
hole_dia      = 2.8        # ø2.8 cross hole through both prongs
hole_from_end = 4.0        # cross hole centre, from the free end

# derived axial positions (origin = pilot tip end)
x_shank   = tip_len                    # 4.1
x_collar  = x_shank + shank_len        # 67.5
x_head    = x_collar + collar_len      # 80.0
total_len = x_head + head_len          # 88.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
#  helper : solid cylinder of revolution about +X, base at x0        #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
def cylinder_x(dia: float, length: float, x0: float):
    return (
        Cylinder(dia / 2.0, length,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
        .rotate(Axis.Y, 90)            # +Z  ->  +X
        .translate((x0, 0, 0))
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
#  body of revolution : pilot - shank - collar - forked head         #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
part = (
    cylinder_x(tip_dia,     tip_len,    0.0)
    + cylinder_x(shank_dia,   shank_len,  x_shank)
    + cylinder_x(collar_dia,  collar_len, x_collar)
    + cylinder_x(head_dia,    head_len,   x_head)
)

# relief groove in the collar (seen in the isometric)
part -= cylinder_x(groove_dia, groove_width, x_collar + groove_offset)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
#  fork : through slot (rounded inner end) + ø2.8 cross hole         #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
slot = Box(slot_depth, 2.0 * head_dia, slot_width,
           align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)
           ).translate((total_len - slot_depth, 0, 0))
slot += (
    Cylinder(slot_width / 2.0, 2.0 * head_dia)      # rounded slot bottom
    .rotate(Axis.X, 90)                             # axis along Y
    .translate((total_len - slot_depth, 0, 0))
)
part -= slot

hole = Cylinder(hole_dia / 2.0, 2.0 * head_dia).translate(
    (total_len - hole_from_end, 0, 0))              # axis along Z
part -= hole

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
#  C0.3 chamfer on the pilot tip                                     #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
tip_edge = part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).group_by(Axis.X)[0]
part = chamfer(tip_edge, length=tip_chamfer)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Reconstruction of part ORION-1190 (draftwright drawing)
=======================================================
Two square bars (10.7 x 10.7 cross-section) crossing in a single plane,
fused into one solid.  Overall bounding box = 80.0 x 62.6 x 10.7 mm,
exactly as dimensioned on the drawing (front view 80 x 62.6,
side/top views give the 10.7 bar thickness).
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions from the drawing (mm) ----------------
OVERALL_WIDTH  = 80.0    # overall horizontal extent  (front view)
OVERALL_HEIGHT = 62.6    # overall vertical extent    (front view)
BAR_WIDTH      = 10.7    # square bar cross-section, in-plane width
BAR_THICK      = 10.7    # square bar cross-section, out-of-plane depth

# The two bars cross obliquely (not at 90 deg) so that the overall
# envelope is 80 x 62.6 - a perpendicular symmetric X would give 80 x 80.
ANG_BAR1 = 40.0          # bar rising to the right  (lower-left -> upper-right)
ANG_BAR2 = 27.5          # bar falling to the right (upper-left -> lower-right)

# Bar length solved so the overall height is reproduced exactly:
#     L*sin(ANG_BAR1) + BAR_WIDTH*cos(ANG_BAR1) = OVERALL_HEIGHT
BAR_LEN = (OVERALL_HEIGHT - BAR_WIDTH * math.cos(math.radians(ANG_BAR1))) \
          / math.sin(math.radians(ANG_BAR1))

# ---------------- geometry ----------------
# Bar 1: long axis along X, rotated up by ANG_BAR1 about the Y axis
bar1 = Rot(0, -ANG_BAR1, 0) * Box(BAR_LEN, BAR_THICK, BAR_WIDTH)

# Bar 2: long axis along X, rotated down by ANG_BAR2 about the Y axis

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
R1 = 122.0          # Top arc radius (centerline)  [mm]
R2 = 121.7          # Bottom arc radius (centerline) [mm]
overall_height = 80.0
bottom_offset = 11.0
width = 5.6         # Strip width (X direction)
thickness = 1.0     # Strip thickness (assumed from top view)

# Vertical component of the short straight end segments.
# Estimated from the front view (the horizontal lines near the ends).
v = 5.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve for the arc angles (degrees) that satisfy the geometry.
# These values were derived from the given dimensions.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
phi1 = 11.43        # Top arc half-angle (degrees)
phi2 = 22.12        # Bottom arc half-angle (degrees)

phi1_rad = math.radians(phi1)
phi2_rad = math.radians(phi2)

# Arc centres in the YZ plane (Y horizontal, Z vertical)
C1 = (R1, 0.0)
C2 = (R2, 0.0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Centreline key points
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
P = (0.0, 0.0)                                      # leftmost point
T1 = (R1 - R1 * math.cos(phi1_rad), R1 * math.sin(phi1_rad))
T2 = (R2 - R2 * math.cos(phi2_rad), -R2 * math.sin(phi2_rad))

# Straight segment lengths
L1 = v / math.cos(phi1_rad)
L2 = v / math.cos(phi2_rad)

# Directions of the straight segments
dir1 = (math.sin(phi1_rad), math.cos(phi1_rad))
dir2 = (math.sin(phi2_rad), -math.cos(phi2_rad))

# End tips of the centreline
T = (T1[0] + L1 * dir1[0], T1[1] + L1 * dir1[1])
B = (T2[0] + L2 * dir2[0], T2[1] + L2 * dir2[1])

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Offsets for the outer and inner edges (thickness/2)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
off = thickness / 2.0

# Outward normals at the tangent points
n1 = (-math.cos(phi1_rad), math.sin(phi1_rad))
n2 = (-math.cos(phi2_rad), -math.sin(phi2_rad))

# Outer boundary points
P_out = (P[0] - off, P[1])          # normal at P is (-1, 0)
T1_out = (T1[0] + off * n1[0], T1[1] + off * n1[1])
T2_out = (T2[0] + off * n2[0], T2[1] + off * n2[1])
T_out = (T[0] + off * n1[0], T[1] + off * n1[1])
B_out = (B[0] + off * n2[0], B[1] + off * n2[1])

# Inner boundary points
P_in = (P[0] + off, P[1])
T1_in = (T1[0] - off * n1[0], T1[1] - off * n1[1])
T2_in = (T2[0] - off * n2[0], T2[1] - off * n2[1])
T_in = (T[0] - off * n1[0], T[1] - off * n1[1])
B_in = (B[0] - off * n2[0], B[1] - off * n2[1])

# Radii for the outer and inner arcs
R1_out = R1 + off
R1_in = R1 - off
R2_out = R2 + off
R2_in = R2 - off

# Angles for the arcs (degrees)
ang_T2 = 180.0 + phi2
ang_P = 180.0
ang_T1 = 180.0 - phi1

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the solid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as profile:
        with BuildLine():
            # Outer boundary (from bottom tip, up the outer edge, to top tip)
            Line(B_out, T2_out)
            CenterArc(center=C2, radius=R2_out, start_angle=ang_T2, arc_size=-phi2)
            CenterArc(center=C1, radius=R1_out, start_angle=ang_P, arc_size=-phi1)
            Line(T1_out, T_out)
            Line(T_out, T_in)          # top flat
            # Inner boundary (from top tip down the inner edge to bottom tip)
            Line(T_in, T1_in)
            CenterArc(center=C1, radius=R1_in, start_angle=ang_T1, arc_size=phi1)
            CenterArc(center=C2, radius=R2_in, start_angle=ang_P, arc_size=phi2)
            Line(T2_in, B_in)
            Line(B_in, B_out)          # bottom flat
        make_face()
    # Extrude symmetrically in the X direction by the strip width
    extrude(amount=width / 2.0, both=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export the result
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part.part, "output.step")

"""

  * Overall envelope ................ 80.0 (X) x 53.3 (Y) x 29.6 (Z)

    with a Ø13.3 through hole (axis Z) at the arc centre.
  * Fork (right): two prongs, each 6.65 thick (Y), separated by a
    40.0 gap, extending from X = 65.2 to X = 80.  In plan (top view)
    each prong is a semicircular tab R14.8 centred on the prong hole,
    so the prongs are 29.6 wide in Z (flush with the body's front face).
  * Each prong has a Ø13.3 through hole (axis Y) at X = 65.2, Z = 14.8
    (i.e. exactly at the inner end of the slot, so the hole's inner half
    also notches the end face of the solid body).
"""

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_length = 80.0        # overall length  (X)
overall_height = 53.3        # overall height  (Y)
overall_depth  = 29.6        # overall depth   (Z)  - width of the fork prongs

body_length    = 65.2        # length of the solid body  (slot inner end)
body_thickness = 14.8        # thickness of the solid body (Z)
end_radius     = 26.7        # R26.7  rounded (semicircular) end of the body

slot_height    = 40.0        # height of the gap between the two prongs
prong_thick    = (overall_height - slot_height) / 2.0    # = 6.65 each
prong_radius   = 14.8        # R14.8  rounded end of each prong (plan view, 2x)

hole_dia       = 13.3        # Ø13.3 THRU  (body hole and prong holes)
hole_r         = hole_dia / 2.0

body_hole_x    = end_radius                 # 26.7  - body hole centre (X)
body_hole_y    = overall_height / 2.0       # 26.65 - body hole centre (Y)
prong_hole_x   = body_length                # 65.2  - prong hole centre (X)
prong_hole_z   = overall_depth / 2.0        # 14.8  - prong hole centre (Z)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Solid body : rounded-end plate 65.2 x 53.3 x 14.8, hole Ø13.3 (axis Z)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
body_profile = make_face(
    Polyline((0, 0), (body_length, 0), (body_length, overall_height),
             (end_radius, overall_height))
    + ThreePointArc((end_radius, overall_height), (0, body_hole_y), (0, 0))
)
body = extrude(body_profile, amount=body_thickness)
body -= Pos(body_hole_x, body_hole_y, body_thickness / 2) * \
        Cylinder(hole_r, body_thickness * 2)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    ThreePointArc((body_length, 0), (overall_length, prong_hole_z),
                  (body_length, overall_depth))
    + Line((body_length, overall_depth), (body_length, 0))
)
prong = extrude(prong_profile, amount=prong_thick)      # grows toward -Y

top_prong    = Pos(0, overall_height, 0) * prong        # Y 46.65 ... 53.3
bottom_prong = Pos(0, prong_thick,     0) * prong       # Y  0.00 ...  6.65

part = body + top_prong + bottom_prong

# 3) Ø13.3 cross hole through both prongs (axis Y).  Because the hole is
#    centred on the inner end of the slot it also produces the semicircular
#    relief in the end face of the solid body.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
part -= Pos(prong_hole_x, body_hole_y, prong_hole_z) * \
        Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_r, overall_height * 2)

"""
Tri-lobe coupling plate  (drawing URSA-6593)
Reconstructed with build123d.
"""
from math import cos, sin, radians, sqrt
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_width   = 80.0     # 80.0   overall width  (X)
overall_depth   = 73.1     # 73.1   overall depth  (Y)
plate_height    = 21.1     # 21.1   overall height (Z)
valley_radius   = 40.4     # 3x R40.4 concave valley arcs
hole_dia        = 22.4     # Ø22.4 THRU central hole
hex_across_corn = 40.4     # 40.4   hex socket across corners
pocket_depth    = 12.0     # hex socket depth (scaled from ISO view)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived lobe / valley geometry
#   lobes   : convex arcs, centres on 30/150/270 deg
#   valleys : concave R40.4 arcs, centres on 90/210/330 deg
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
C30, S30 = cos(radians(30.0)), sin(radians(30.0))

# Envelope equations:
#   2*(lobe_dist*cos30 + lobe_radius)          = overall_width
#   (lobe_dist + lobe_radius) + (lobe_dist*sin30 + lobe_radius) = overall_depth
lobe_dist   = (overall_width - overall_depth) / (2.0 * C30 - 1.5)
lobe_radius = overall_width / 2.0 - C30 * lobe_dist

# Valley arc centre radius from external tangency |F-V| = lobe_radius + valley_radius
valley_dist = lobe_dist * S30 + sqrt((lobe_radius + valley_radius) ** 2
                                     - (lobe_dist * C30) ** 2)

def pol(r, a):
    return (r * cos(radians(a)), r * sin(radians(a)))

def unit(v):
    n = sqrt(v[0] ** 2 + v[1] ** 2)
    return (v[0] / n, v[1] / n)

lobe_c   = [pol(lobe_dist,   30.0 + 120.0 * k) for k in range(3)]
valley_c = [pol(valley_dist, 90.0 + 120.0 * k) for k in range(3)]

def tangency(lobe_i, valley_j):
    """Point where lobe arc i is tangent to valley arc j."""
    F, V = lobe_c[lobe_i], valley_c[valley_j]
    u = unit((V[0] - F[0], V[1] - F[1]))
    return (F[0] + u[0] * lobe_radius, F[1] + u[1] * lobe_radius)

# Build the 6 alternating arcs (lobe, valley, lobe, valley, ...)
profile_arcs = []
for k in range(3):
    # convex lobe arc (k) : from valley (k-1) to valley (k)
    p_start = tangency(k, (k - 1) % 3)
    p_end   = tangency(k, k)
    u_tip   = unit(lobe_c[k])
    p_mid   = (lobe_c[k][0] + u_tip[0] * lobe_radius,
               lobe_c[k][1] + u_tip[1] * lobe_radius)
    profile_arcs.append((p_start, p_mid, p_end))

    # concave valley arc (k) : from lobe (k) to lobe (k+1)
    v_start = tangency(k, k)
    v_end   = tangency((k + 1) % 3, k)
    v_mid   = pol(valley_dist - valley_radius, 90.0 + 120.0 * k)
    profile_arcs.append((v_start, v_mid, v_end))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the solid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # --- outer tri-lobe profile, extruded to full height ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            for a0, a1, a2 in profile_arcs:
                ThreePointArc(a0, a1, a2)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_height)

    # --- hexagonal socket, blind from the top face ---
    hex_r = hex_across_corn / 2.0
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*[pol(hex_r, 30.0 + 60.0 * k) for k in range(6)], close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_height - pocket_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- central through hole ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(hole_dia / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=plate_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

solid = part.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity check + export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
bb = solid.bounding_box()
print(f"lobe_dist   = {lobe_dist:.3f}")
print(f"lobe_radius = {lobe_radius:.3f}")
print(f"valley_dist = {valley_dist:.3f}")
print(f"bbox X = {bb.size.X:.2f}  (target {overall_width})")
print(f"bbox Y = {bb.size.Y:.2f}  (target {overall_depth})")
print(f"bbox Z = {bb.size.Z:.2f}  (target {plate_height})")

export_step(solid, "output.step")

"""

Part: regular hexagonal plate (prism) with a central through hole.

Views:
  * Front view : regular hexagon, 120 deg corners, across-flats 69.3,
                 side length 40 (=> across-corners 80), hole dia 24 THRU.
  * Top view   : 80 (across-corners) x 24 (prism length), hole hidden lines.
  * Side view  : 24 (prism length) x 69.3 (across-flats), 34.6 = half of
                 across-flats locates the centered hole axis.
"""

import math
from build123d import (
    BuildPart, BuildSketch, BuildLine, Polyline, make_face,
    Circle, extrude, Mode, Plane, export_step,
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key (parametric) dimensions taken from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
HEX_SIDE = 40.0                                  # hexagon side length (drawing: 40)
HEX_ACROSS_CORNERS = 2.0 * HEX_SIDE              # 80.0  (drawing: 80)
HEX_ACROSS_FLATS = HEX_SIDE * math.sqrt(3.0)     # 69.28 (drawing: 69.3)
PLATE_THICKNESS = 24.0                           # prism length along axis (drawing: 24)
HOLE_DIA = 24.0                                  # central hole, dia 24 THRU
HOLE_RADIUS = HOLE_DIA / 2.0
CENTER_FROM_EDGE = HEX_ACROSS_FLATS / 2.0        # 34.64 (drawing: 34.6) -> hole is centered

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hexagon profile: regular hexagon with vertices on the X axis
# (flat top and bottom edges, pointy left/right) as in the front view.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hex_vertices = [
    (
        HEX_SIDE * math.cos(math.radians(60.0 * i)),
        HEX_SIDE * math.sin(math.radians(60.0 * i)),
    )
    for i in range(6)
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the solid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as hex_plate:
    # Hexagonal prism
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*hex_vertices, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=PLATE_THICKNESS)

    # Central through hole (dia 24 THRU), axis normal to the hexagon face
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(radius=HOLE_RADIUS)
    extrude(amount=PLATE_THICKNESS, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = hex_plate.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
bb = part.bounding_box()
print(f"Bounding box : X {bb.size.X:.3f}  Y {bb.size.Y:.3f}  Z {bb.size.Z:.3f}")
print(f"Across corners : {HEX_ACROSS_CORNERS:.3f}")
print(f"Across flats   : {HEX_ACROSS_FLATS:.3f}")
print(f"Thickness      : {PLATE_THICKNESS:.3f}")
print(f"Volume         : {part.volume:.1f} mm^3")

export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
SIGMA-6067  -  triangular gusset bracket
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing (ISO 2768-m, 1:1).

Views used:
  * front view : right-triangle profile, 59.8 wide x 80 tall, with a
                 triangular through-opening  ->  triangular frame
  * side views : 23.9 deep, R2.4 corner fillets
  * iso view   : triangular frame + central vertical rib
"""
import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions taken from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
W = 59.8        # overall width  (X)
H = 80.0        # overall height (Z)
D = 23.9        # overall depth  (Y)
T = 9.0         # frame wall / rib thickness
R = 2.4         # corner fillet radius  (R2.4)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Triangular frame profile (drawn in the XZ plane)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
slant_len = math.hypot(W, H)
c_out = W * H                  # outer slant line : H*x + W*z = c_out
c_in  = c_out - T * slant_len  # inner slant line (offset inward by T)

outer_pts = [(0.0, 0.0), (W, 0.0), (0.0, H)]
inner_pts = [
    (T, T),                              # inner bottom-left corner
    ((c_in - W * T) / H, T),             # inner bottom-right corner
    (T, (c_in - H * T) / W),             # inner top corner
]

frame_profile = (Plane.XZ * Polygon(*outer_pts, align=None)
                 - Plane.XZ * Polygon(*inner_pts, align=None))

frame = extrude(frame_profile, amount=D, dir=(0, 1, 0))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Central vertical rib (spans the full depth, blends into the slant)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
rib_x1 = 15.4                       # centred in the opening
rib_x2 = rib_x1 + T
rib_z1 = (c_in - H * rib_x1) / W    # top of rib follows inner slant
rib_z2 = (c_in - H * rib_x2) / W

rib_profile = Plane.XZ * Polygon(
    [(rib_x1, T), (rib_x2, T), (rib_x2, rib_z2), (rib_x1, rib_z1)],
    align=None)
rib = extrude(rib_profile, amount=D, dir=(0, 1, 0))

part = frame + rib

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2.4 fillets on the vertical corner edges (9x / 4x R2.4 callouts)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def vertical_edge_at(x, z):
    for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y):
        c = e.center()
        if abs(c.X - x) < 0.6 and abs(c.Z - z) < 0.6:
            return e
    return None

corners = [
    (0.0, 0.0), (W, 0.0), (0.0, H),                            # outer corners
    (T, T), ((c_in - W * T) / H, T), (T, (c_in - H * T) / W),  # inner corners
    (rib_x1, rib_z1), (rib_x2, rib_z2),                        # rib corners
]
fillet_edges = [e for e in (vertical_edge_at(x, z) for x, z in corners) if e]
part = fillet(fillet_edges, R)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
TITAN-2817  (ISO 2768-m, 1:1)
Three-nozzle manifold plate.

  * Mounting plate  80.0 x 46.1 x 4.0 thick
  * Three tubular bosses on the back face:
        X = 19.0 : OD 16.4, length 60, bore Ø11.3 x 60 deep
        X = 41.2 : OD 17.0, length 40, bore Ø12.3 x 40 deep
        X = 65.3 : OD 17.2, length 30, bore Ø12.8 x 30 deep
  * Triangular stiffening rib along the bottom edge of the back face
    (full width, 20 deep, 20 high, R1.0 / R1.6 corners)
"""

from build123d import *
from math import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Key (parametric) dimensions                                         #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
plate_w = 80.0        # overall width                       (X)
plate_h = 46.1        # overall height                      (Z)
plate_t = 4.0         # plate thickness  (64.0 - 60.0)      (Y)

# boss table: (x-centre, outer Ø, length, bore Ø, bore depth, top height)
bosses = [
    (19.0, 16.4, 60.0, 11.3, 60.0, 36.4),
    (41.2, 17.0, 40.0, 12.3, 40.0, 35.6),
    (65.3, 17.2, 30.0, 12.8, 30.0, 36.6),
]

rib_depth  = 20.0     # stiffening rib reach from back face
rib_height = 20.0     # stiffening rib height at the plate
r_plate    = 1.0      # 2 x R1.0  (plate top edges)
r_rib_tip  = 1.0      # R1.0      (rib tip corner)
r_rib_root = 1.6      # R1.6      (rib root / plate junction)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Build                                                               #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
with BuildPart() as part:

    # ---- mounting plate (80 x 46.1 x 4) ---------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):                       # local X = global X, local Y = global Z
        with Locations((plate_w / 2, plate_h / 2)):
            Rectangle(plate_w, plate_h)
    extrude(amount=-plate_t)                          # Plane.XZ normal is -Y -> +Y

    # ---- tubular bosses and their bores ---------------------------
    for x, od, length, bore_d, bore_depth, top_z in bosses:
        zc = top_z - od / 2.0                         # boss centre height

        # boss (axis along +Y, starting on the plate back face)
        with Locations(Location((x, plate_t, zc), (-90, 0, 0))):
            Cylinder(od / 2.0, length,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

        # bore, drilled from the plate front face
        with Locations(Location((x, 0.0, zc), (-90, 0, 0))):
            Cylinder(bore_d / 2.0, bore_depth,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                     mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- triangular stiffening rib (full width) -------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):                       # local X = global Y, local Y = global Z
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((plate_t, 0.0),
                     (plate_t + rib_depth, 0.0),
                     (plate_t, rib_height),
                     close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_w)                           # along +X, full plate width

    # ---- corner radii ---------------------------------------------
    try:                                              # 2 x R1.0 : plate top edges
        top_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.X).group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
        fillet(top_edges, r_plate)
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:                                              # R1.0 : rib tip edge
        tip_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.X).filter_by(
            lambda e: abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6 and
                      abs(e.center().Y - (plate_t + rib_depth)) < 1e-6)
        fillet(tip_edges, r_rib_tip)
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:                                              # R1.6 : rib root against plate
        root_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.X).filter_by(
            lambda e: abs(e.center().Y - plate_t) < 1e-6 and
                      abs(e.center().Z - rib_height) < 1e-6)
        fillet(root_edges, r_rib_root)
    except Exception:
        pass

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Export                                                              #
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
export_step(part.part, "output.step")

Reconstructed from drawing 1:1 (ISO 2768-m)

  * overall thickness     : 15.1
  * counterbore (recess)  : ø64.9 x 9.1 deep  (floor thickness 6.0)
  * through hole          : ø37.7

outer_dia   = 80.0                     # outer diameter

total_thk   = 15.1                     # overall thickness

cbore_r     = cbore_dia / 2.0          # 32.45
cbore_depth = 9.1                      # counterbore depth
floor_thk   = total_thk - cbore_depth  # 6.0 remaining floor

hole_dia    = 37.7                     # central through hole
hole_r      = hole_dia / 2.0           # 18.85

            # R7.5 full round: tangent to ø80 cylinder, tangent to front face
            # at the counterbore edge (mid point of arc at 45 deg from centre)

                (outer_r, z_round_start),
                (cbore_r + rim_round_r * math.cos(math.radians(45.0)),
                 z_round_start + rim_round_r * math.sin(math.radians(45.0))),
                (cbore_r, total_thk),

            # ø64.9 counterbore wall
            Line((cbore_r, total_thk), (cbore_r, floor_thk))
            # counterbore floor
            Line((cbore_r, floor_thk), (hole_r, floor_thk))
            # ø37.7 hole wall
            Line((hole_r, floor_thk), (hole_r, 0.0))
            # back face, inner portion
            Line((hole_r, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

part = cap.part

# ---------------- export ----------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
H = 80.0          # overall height (front / side view)
W = 57.5          # overall width  (front view / top view length)
D = 22.2          # overall depth  (side view / top view depth)
t = 2.0           # shell thickness (estimated from edge view)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Front view D-shape (major circular segment)
#   chord = H = 80, sagitta = W = 57.5
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
R1 = (W**2 + (H/2)**2) / (2.0 * W)          # arc radius
Xc1 = W - R1                                # arc centre X

def Z_max(x: float) -> float:
    """Half-height of the front D-shape at abscissa x."""
    val = R1**2 - (x - Xc1)**2
    return math.sqrt(val) if val > 0.0 else 0.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Side view D-shape (minor circular segment)
#   chord = H = 80, sagitta = D = 22.2
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
R2 = (D**2 + (H/2)**2) / (2.0 * D)          # arc radius
Yc2 = D - R2                                # arc centre Y

def f(z: float) -> float:
    """Y coordinate of the side-view arc at height z."""
    val = R2**2 - z**2
    return Yc2 + math.sqrt(val) if val > 0.0 else 0.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Top view curve (mid-surface at Z = 0)
#   approximated by a smooth curve through:
#   (0,0) -> (10,0) -> (30,10) -> (57.5,22.2)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def g(x: float) -> float:
    """Y coordinate of the top-view curve at abscissa x."""
    if x <= 10.0:
        return 0.0
    elif x <= 30.0:
        return (x - 10.0) / 20.0 * 10.0
    else:
        return 10.0 + (x - 30.0) / (W - 30.0) * (D - 10.0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the shell by lofting a series of thin cross-sections
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
X_samples = [0.0, 5.0, 10.0, 15.0, 20.0, 25.0, 30.0,
             35.0, 40.0, 45.0, 50.0, 55.0, W]

sections = []
for x in X_samples:
    zmax = Z_max(x)
    if zmax < 0.1:          # avoid degenerate section at the very tip
        continue

    # sample the mid-surface curve at this x
    n = 24
    left_pts  = []
    right_pts = []
    for i in range(n + 1):
        z = -zmax + 2.0 * zmax * i / n
        yc = (f(z) / D) * g(x)
        left_pts.append((x, yc - t/2.0, z))
        right_pts.append((x, yc + t/2.0, z))

    # closed wire: left curve bottom->top, across, right curve top->bottom, across
    wire_pts = left_pts + list(reversed(right_pts)) + [left_pts[0]]
    wire = Wire.make_polygon([Vector(p) for p in wire_pts], close=True)
    sections.append(wire)

# loft the cross-sections into a solid
part = loft(sections)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

pin_embed = pin_length - pin_protrusion

"""
FALCON-9282  -  bent-plate corner bracket (L-angle)
Reconstructed from drawing: 80.0 x 55.1 x 76.9, plate 11.0 thick,
outer bend R16.5, inner bend R5.5, edge rounds R4.6 (15x).
"""
from build123d import *

# ---------------- key dimensions (mm) ----------------
WIDTH  = 55.1                 # overall width (extrusion depth)
LENGTH = 80.0                 # overall length of horizontal leg
HEIGHT = 76.9                 # overall height of vertical leg
H_FLAT = 65.9                 # height of horizontal leg underside
THICK  = HEIGHT - H_FLAT      # 11.0  plate thickness
R_OUT  = 16.5                 # outer corner radius
R_IN   = R_OUT - THICK        # 5.5   inner corner radius
R_EDGE = 4.6                  # 15x R4.6 edge rounds

with BuildPart() as bracket:
    # ---------- L-shaped profile drawn on the XZ plane ----------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as profile:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((0.0, 0.0), (THICK, 0.0), (THICK, H_FLAT - R_IN))
            CenterArc((THICK + R_IN, H_FLAT - R_IN), R_IN, 180.0, -90.0)   # inner bend
            Polyline((THICK + R_IN, H_FLAT), (LENGTH, H_FLAT),
                     (LENGTH, HEIGHT), (R_OUT, HEIGHT))
            CenterArc((R_OUT, HEIGHT - R_OUT), R_OUT, 90.0, 90.0)          # outer bend
            Line((0.0, HEIGHT - R_OUT), (0.0, 0.0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=WIDTH / 2, both=True)

    # ---------- R4.6 edge rounds ----------
    inner_axis_pt = Vector(THICK + R_IN, 0.0, H_FLAT - R_IN)   # inner bend axis
    y_dir = Vector(0, 1, 0)

    def in_inner_bend(p, tol=R_IN + 0.05):
        """True if point lies on the inner bend cylinder."""
        v = p - inner_axis_pt
        return (v - y_dir * v.dot(y_dir)).length < tol

    edges_to_round = []
    for e in bracket.edges():
        p0, p1 = e.position_at(0), e.position_at(1)
        # leave the inner bend cylinder edges sharp (fillet would overlap)
        if in_inner_bend(p0) or in_inner_bend(p1):
            continue
        # leave the smooth (tangent) longitudinal edges of the outer bend sharp
        if e.geom_type == GeomType.LINE:
            d = p1 - p0
            if abs(d.X) < 1e-6 and abs(d.Z) < 1e-6:          # edge runs along Y
                c = e.center()
                if (abs(c.X - R_OUT) < 1e-3 and abs(c.Z - HEIGHT) < 1e-3) or \
                   (abs(c.X) < 1e-3 and abs(c.Z - (HEIGHT - R_OUT)) < 1e-3):
                    continue
        edges_to_round.append(e)

    fillet(edges_to_round, radius=R_EDGE)

export_step(bracket.part, "output.step")

"""
Reconstruction of part SIGMA-3334 (draftwright, ISO 2768-m, 1:1)
Obround link plate with two opposite cylindrical bosses and two through holes.
"""

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions taken from the drawing (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
hole_spacing    = 80.0                      # 80  : distance between hole centres
end_radius      = 16.0                      # 2x R16 : obround end radius
plate_width     = 2.0 * end_radius          # 32  : plate width  (Detail A / side view)
plate_length    = hole_spacing + 2.0 * end_radius   # 112 : overall length
plate_thickness = 8.0                       # derived: 56 - 24 - 24 (front view)
boss_dia        = 32.0                      # boss diameter (side view dim 32, flush with R16 ends)
boss_height     = 24.0                      # 24  : height of each boss
hole_dia        = 16.0                      # ø16 : through holes
total_height    = 56.0                      # 56  : overall height (front view)

# Consistency check of the stacked heights
assert abs((boss_height + plate_thickness + boss_height) - total_height) < 1e-9

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Obround base plate (SlotOverall: overall length x overall width), extruded up
plate = extrude(SlotOverall(plate_length, plate_width), plate_thickness)

# Boss on TOP of the left end (aligned with the left hole centre)
boss_top = Pos(-hole_spacing / 2, 0, plate_thickness) * Cylinder(
    boss_dia / 2, boss_height,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
)

# Boss on BOTTOM of the right end (aligned with the right hole centre)
boss_bot = Pos(hole_spacing / 2, 0, 0) * Cylinder(
    boss_dia / 2, boss_height,
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MAX),
)

part = plate + boss_top + boss_bot

# Two ø16 holes drilled through plate and bosses
for x in (-hole_spacing / 2, hole_spacing / 2):
    part -= Pos(x, 0, -boss_height) * Cylinder(
        hole_dia / 2, total_height,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

Reconstruction of the part from the drawing (AEROSPACE-7943).

Interpreted geometry:
- A flat rectangular link/bar, overall length 80 mm.
- Main body: width 16 mm, thickness 3.2 mm.
- Left end has a reduced tab: length 10.5 mm (80 - 69.5), width 6.4 mm,
  thickness 1.6 mm (assumed half of main thickness, step is on the bottom).
- The tab end is rounded. The drawing gives R5.6, but since the tab width is
  only 6.4 mm, the maximum possible end radius is 3.2 mm (full round).
  The R5.6 is therefore not geometrically possible for the tab; the model uses
  a full round R3.2 on the tab end.
- Through hole: Ø12.2, located 56.0 mm from the left end, centered in width.
"""

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parametric dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
L = 80.0          # overall length
W = 16.0          # main body width
T = 3.2           # main body thickness

L_tab = 10.5      # tab length (80 - 69.5)
W_tab = 6.4       # tab width
T_tab = 1.6       # tab thickness (assumed half of main thickness)

D_hole = 12.2     # through hole diameter
X_hole = 56.0     # hole centre distance from left end

# The tab end is a full round because R5.6 > W_tab/2.
R_tab = W_tab / 2.0   # = 3.2 mm

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the solid
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main body: rectangular block
main_sk = Rectangle(L, W, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER))
main_body = extrude(main_sk, T)

# Tab: rectangular block with a rounded left end
tab_sk = Rectangle(L_tab, W_tab, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER))
# Fillet the two left corners to create the full round end
left_vertices = tab_sk.vertices().filter_by(lambda v: abs(v.X) < 1e-6)
tab_sk = fillet(left_vertices, radius=R_tab)
tab = extrude(tab_sk, T_tab)

# Position the tab so its top face is flush with the main body top face
# (the step is on the bottom, as seen in the front view).
tab = tab.translate((0, 0, T / 2.0 - T_tab))

# Combine main body and tab
part = main_body + tab

# Through hole
hole = Cylinder(
    radius=D_hole / 2.0,
    height=T * 2.0,          # long enough to cut through
    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER),
)
hole = hole.translate((X_hole, 0, 0))
part = part - hole

# Export

overall_height = 49.2     # Z - overall height

    fillet(circular_edges(ro, -hh), r_outer_bot)   # R5.2 bottom outer edge

"""
VEGA-7634 - spoked wheel
Reconstructed from multi-view drawing (ISO 2768-m, 1:1)

Features:
  - Rim ring  : Ø80 OD / Ø72 ID (2 x R36) x 20 long
  - Spokes    : 4x, 10 wide x 15 thick, flush with back face
  - Hub       : Ø16, protruding 8 beyond the front face (28 total)
  - Center    : hex hole 8.0 A/F, through
  - Fillets   : R2 at every spoke-to-hub and spoke-to-rim junction
"""
from math import cos, radians
from build123d import *

# ---------------- Key dimensions (mm) ----------------
RIM_OD          = 80.0          # rim outside diameter
RIM_ID          = 72.0          # rim bore diameter  (2 x R36)
RIM_LEN         = 20.0          # rim axial length

HUB_OD          = 16.0          # hub outside diameter
HUB_PROTRUSION  = 8.0           # hub length beyond front face
HUB_LEN         = RIM_LEN + HUB_PROTRUSION   # 28 overall hub length

HEX_AF          = 8.0           # central hex hole, across flats
HEX_R           = HEX_AF / 2.0 / cos(radians(30.0))   # circumscribed radius

SPOKE_COUNT     = 4
SPOKE_WIDTH     = 10.0          # tangential width of each spoke
SPOKE_THICK     = 15.0          # axial thickness (recessed 5 from front face)
FILLET_R        = 2.0           # 7x R2 junction fillets

# ---------------- Rim (Ø80 / Ø72 x 20) ----------------
rim = Pos(0, 0, RIM_LEN / 2) * Cylinder(RIM_OD / 2, RIM_LEN)
rim -= Pos(0, 0, RIM_LEN / 2) * Cylinder(RIM_ID / 2, RIM_LEN)

# ---------------- Hub (Ø16 x 28, flush with back face) ----------------
hub = Pos(0, 0, HUB_LEN / 2) * Cylinder(HUB_OD / 2, HUB_LEN)

# ---------------- Spoked web ----------------
# 2D profile: hub disc + rim ring + 4 spoke rectangles, then fillet the
# re-entrant corners where the spokes meet the hub and the rim bore.
web_profile = Circle(HUB_OD / 2) + (Circle(RIM_OD / 2) - Circle(RIM_ID / 2))

spoke_len = RIM_ID / 2 + 2.0    # extend slightly into the rim wall
for i in range(SPOKE_COUNT):
    web_profile += Rot(0, 0, i * 360.0 / SPOKE_COUNT) * Rectangle(
        spoke_len, SPOKE_WIDTH, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER)
    )

# Corners at the hub circle (r = 8) and the rim bore circle (r = 36)
corner_verts = [
    v for v in web_profile.vertices()
    if 6.0 < (v.X ** 2 + v.Y ** 2) ** 0.5 < 37.0
]
web_profile = fillet(corner_verts, radius=FILLET_R)

web = extrude(web_profile, amount=SPOKE_THICK)

# ---------------- Assemble ----------------
part = rim + hub + web

# ---------------- Central hex hole 8.0 A/F (through) ----------------
part -= extrude(RegularPolygon(HEX_R, side_count=6), amount=HUB_LEN)

# ---------------- Export ----------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
Clevis / fork bracket - reconstructed from drawing GEMINI-8401.

Front view : 80 long, hole Ø15.6 @ 21.5 from left end, 29.3 above bottom,
             2x R11.7 prong ends, R29.3 relief arc, top-left corner R11.7,
             right-hand step (78 long base).
Top view   : 80 x 29.3, fork slot open to the left.
Bottom view: 78 long base, slot 63.4 deep.
Section A-A: two prongs joined by the web at the right.
"""

from build123d import *

# ------------------------- key dimensions (mm) -------------------------
LENGTH     = 80.0      # overall length                    (X)
DEPTH      = 29.3      # overall depth                     (Y)
HEIGHT     = 77.5      # overall height                    (Z)

HOLE_DIA   = 15.6      # clevis pin hole
HOLE_X     = 21.5      # hole centre from left end
HOLE_Z     = 29.3      # hole centre above bottom

END_R      = 11.7      # 2x prong end radius
ARC_R      = 29.3      # corner relief arc radius (tangent L-edge & bottom)
CORNER_R   = 11.7      # top-left corner radius

SLOT_DEPTH = 63.4      # fork slot depth from left end
SLOT_W     = 15.0      # fork slot width
PRONG_T    = (DEPTH - SLOT_W) / 2.0     # 7.15 prong thickness

BASE_LEN   = 78.0      # base block length (right hand step)

PRONG_BOT  = HOLE_Z - END_R             # 17.6
PRONG_TOP  = HOLE_Z + END_R             # 41.0
WEB_X      = SLOT_DEPTH                 # 63.4  slot end / web face

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bracket:

    # ---------------- main side profile, extruded through depth --------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as profile:
        with BuildLine():
            # left edge (above the relief arc)
            Line((0, ARC_R), (0, HEIGHT - CORNER_R))
            # top-left corner R11.7
            ThreePointArc((0, HEIGHT - CORNER_R),
                          (CORNER_R * (1 - 0.7071),
                           HEIGHT - CORNER_R + CORNER_R * 0.7071),
                          (CORNER_R, HEIGHT))
            # top edge
            Line((CORNER_R, HEIGHT), (LENGTH, HEIGHT))
            # right edge above step
            Line((LENGTH, HEIGHT), (LENGTH, PRONG_TOP))
            # step
            Line((LENGTH, PRONG_TOP), (BASE_LEN, PRONG_TOP))
            # right edge below step
            Line((BASE_LEN, PRONG_TOP), (BASE_LEN, 0))
            # bottom edge
            Line((BASE_LEN, 0), (ARC_R, 0))
            # R29.3 relief arc, tangent to left edge and bottom
            ThreePointArc((ARC_R, 0),
                          (ARC_R * (1 - 0.7071), ARC_R * (1 - 0.7071)),
                          (0, ARC_R))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=DEPTH, dir=(0, 1, 0))

    # ---------------- trim material in front of rounded prong ends -----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations(((HOLE_X - 5.0) / 2.0, (PRONG_BOT + PRONG_TOP) / 2.0)):
            Rectangle(HOLE_X + 5.0, PRONG_TOP - PRONG_BOT)
        with Locations((HOLE_X, HOLE_Z)):
            Circle(END_R, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=DEPTH, dir=(0, 1, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------- fork slot (open at left end) ---------------------
    with Locations((SLOT_DEPTH / 2.0 - 1.0, DEPTH / 2.0,
                    (PRONG_BOT + PRONG_TOP) / 2.0)):
        Box(SLOT_DEPTH + 2.0, SLOT_W, PRONG_TOP - PRONG_BOT,
            mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------- pin hole Ø15.6 through both prongs ---------------
    with Locations((HOLE_X, DEPTH / 2.0, HOLE_Z)):
        Cylinder(HOLE_DIA / 2.0, DEPTH + 2.0, rotation=(90, 0, 0),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

export_step(bracket.part, "output.step")

Boss bracket - reconstructed from drawing GEMINI-4681 (draftwright)

  * side view  : plate edge-on, boss = R13.0 circle, hole = ⌀13.0 THRU
  * front view : plate 30.8 x 80, boss silhouette 27.0 / 52.7

from math import sqrt, atan2, degrees

# dimensions taken from the drawing (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_w   = 30.8      # plate width  (Y)                 "30.8"
plate_h   = 80.0      # plate height (Z)                 "80"
boss_r    = 13.0      # boss radius                      "R13.0"
boss_cz   = 40.0      # boss axis height                 "40"
hole_d    = 13.0      # through hole                     "⌀13.0 THRU"
fil_r     = 6.2       # blend fillets                    "2x R6.2"
overall_d = 29.3      # boss front face -> plate back    "29.3"

back_x = overall_d - boss_r   # plate back  face X = 16.3
face_x = boss_r               # plate front face X = 13.0 (boss tangent)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# derived geometry of the R6.2 blend (tangent to boss O.D. and plate face)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
d  = boss_r + fil_r                      # 19.2  boss centre -> fillet centre
cx = face_x - fil_r                      # 6.8   fillet centre X
cz = sqrt(d * d - cx * cx)               # 17.964 fillet centre Z offset

top_c = (cx, boss_cz + cz)               # upper fillet centre
bot_c = (cx, boss_cz - cz)               # lower fillet centre

A = (face_x, boss_cz + cz)               # blend tangent on plate face (upper)
B = (face_x, boss_cz - cz)               # blend tangent on plate face (lower)
D = (boss_r * cx / d, boss_cz - boss_r * cz / d)   # blend tangent on boss (lower)
E = (boss_r * cx / d, boss_cz + boss_r * cz / d)   # blend tangent on boss (upper)

angB  = degrees(atan2(B[1] - bot_c[1], B[0] - bot_c[0]))
angD2 = degrees(atan2(D[1] - bot_c[1], D[0] - bot_c[0]))
angD  = degrees(atan2(D[1] - boss_cz, D[0]))
angE  = degrees(atan2(E[1] - boss_cz, E[0]))
angE2 = degrees(atan2(E[1] - top_c[1], E[0] - top_c[0]))
angA  = degrees(atan2(A[1] - top_c[1], A[0] - top_c[0]))

    # side profile (XZ plane) extruded across the full 30.8 width
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Line(A, (face_x, plate_h))                    # plate front face, upper
            Line((face_x, plate_h), (back_x, plate_h))    # plate top
            Line((back_x, plate_h), (back_x, 0.0))        # plate back face
            Line((back_x, 0.0), (face_x, 0.0))            # plate bottom
            Line((face_x, 0.0), B)                        # plate front face, lower

            CenterArc((0.0, boss_cz), boss_r, angD, angE - angD - 360)  # boss O.D.
            CenterArc(top_c, fil_r, angE2, angA - angE2)                # upper blend
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=-plate_w)

    # ⌀13.0 through hole on the boss axis
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations((0.0, boss_cz)):
            Circle(hole_d / 2)
    extrude(amount=-plate_w, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

"""
Reconstruction of drawing  O. LARSSON AEROSPACE-2212:1  (draftwright, ISO 2768-m)

Stepped hex-socket adapter, axis along +X:
    - ø32 x 32 left barrel with 26.7 A/F hex socket, 10.7 deep
    - ø42.7 x 16 collar
    - ø32 x 32 right barrel
    - internal bore ø26.9 (collar, ends 8.1 inside collar) / ø21.3 (right barrel)
    - ø8.1 x 18.8 cross hole located 64 from the left end face
"""
from math import cos, radians
from build123d import *

# ---------------- axial chain (from left end face) ----------------
hex_depth  = 10.7          # hex socket depth
left_len   = 21.3          # socket bottom -> collar left face
collar_len = 16.0          # collar width
right_len  = 32.0          # collar right face -> right end face
total_len  = hex_depth + left_len + collar_len + right_len   # 80.0

# ---------------- diameters ----------------
dia_left   = 32.0          # ø32 left barrel
dia_collar = 42.7          # ø42.7 collar
dia_right  = 32.0          # ø32 right barrel

hex_af     = 26.7                              # hex socket across flats
hex_cr     = hex_af / (2.0 * cos(radians(30))) # circumscribed radius

bore_big   = 26.9          # collar bore = 42.7 - 2 * 7.9   (Detail A)
bore_big_x = 8.1           # bore ends 8.1 inside the collar (Detail A)
bore_small = 21.3          # main bore, open at the right end

xhole_dia   = 8.1          # ø8.1 cross hole
xhole_depth = 18.8         # depth 18.8
xhole_pos   = 64.0         # from left end face

# ---------------- helper ----------------
def cyl_x(dia, length, x0):
    """Solid cylinder, axis along +X, starting at x = x0."""
    return Pos(x0, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(
        dia / 2, length, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- body ----------------
part  = cyl_x(dia_left,   hex_depth + left_len, 0.0)
part += cyl_x(dia_collar, collar_len, hex_depth + left_len)
part += cyl_x(dia_right,  right_len,  hex_depth + left_len + collar_len)

# ---------------- hex socket (26.7 A/F, 10.7 deep, flats top/bottom) ----
hex_socket = Rot(0, 90, 0) * extrude(
    RegularPolygon(hex_cr, 6, rotation=30), amount=hex_depth)
part -= hex_socket

# ---------------- internal bores ----------------
big_len = left_len + bore_big_x                       # 29.4
part -= cyl_x(bore_big,   big_len, hex_depth)         # ø26.9  x 10.7 -> 40.1
part -= cyl_x(bore_small, total_len - hex_depth - big_len,
              hex_depth + big_len)                    # ø21.3  x 40.1 -> 80

# ---------------- ø8.1 x 18.8 cross hole ----------------
part -= Pos(xhole_pos, -dia_right / 2, 0) * Rot(-90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(
    xhole_dia / 2, xhole_depth, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

export_step(part, "output.step")

"""
HELIOS-9297  (draftwright)  -  dished flange with 4 radial ribs, hub, bore and shaft.
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing (front, side, iso, DETAIL A - 6:1).
Units: mm.  Axis of revolution = Z.
"""

from build123d import *
from math import radians

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ parameters
FLANGE_OD    = 80.0     # Ø80    flange outside diameter
RECESS_D     = 71.4     # Ø71.4  recess diameter (rim inner wall)
RECESS_DEPTH = 4.3      # 4.3    recess depth  (= rim thickness, DETAIL A)
HUB_OD       = 45.7     # Ø45.7  hub outside diameter
BORE_D       = 31.4     # Ø31.4  central bore
BORE_DEPTH   = 35.0     #        bore depth (blind, from front face)
SHAFT_D      = 14.3     # Ø14.3  shaft diameter (14.3 A/F note)
OVERALL_LEN  = 62.9     # 62.9   overall length
WEB_SEG1     = 7.1      # 7.1    conical web, axial segment 1   (DETAIL A)
WEB_SEG2     = 11.4     # 11.4   conical web, axial segment 2   (DETAIL A)
TAIL_LEN     = 40.0     # 40     hub + shaft axial length       (DETAIL A)
RIB_W        = 17.1     # 17.1   rib width          (4x 17.1)
RIB_N        = 4        # 4x     number of radial ribs
RIB_DRAFT    = 22.6     # 22.6°  rib draft angle (reference)
RIB_THK      = 4.3      #        rib thickness (axial, per DETAIL A)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ derived
R_FLANGE = FLANGE_OD / 2.0      # 40.00
R_RECESS = RECESS_D  / 2.0      # 35.70
R_HUB    = HUB_OD    / 2.0      # 22.85
R_BORE   = BORE_D    / 2.0      # 15.70
R_SHAFT  = SHAFT_D   / 2.0      #  7.15

Z_RECESS    = RECESS_DEPTH                #  4.3   recess floor / cone start
Z_WEB1      = Z_RECESS + WEB_SEG1         # 11.4
Z_WEB2      = Z_WEB1   + WEB_SEG2         # 22.8   cone end / hub start
Z_HUB_END   = Z_WEB2   + 17.2             # 40.0   hub end face
Z_SHAFT_END = OVERALL_LEN                 # 62.9   shaft end
Z_BORE_END  = BORE_DEPTH                  # 35.0   blind bore bottom


def revolve_pts(pts):
    """Revolve a closed (r, z) polygon about the Z axis (full 360°)."""
    face = Plane.XZ * Polygon(*pts, align=None)
    return revolve(face, Axis.Z, 360.0)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ main body
# rim ring : flat annular front face Ø80 -> Ø71.4, 4.3 thick
rim = revolve_pts([
    (R_RECESS, 0.0), (R_FLANGE, 0.0),
    (R_FLANGE, Z_RECESS), (R_RECESS, Z_RECESS),
])

# conical web : Ø71.4 @ z=4.3  ->  Ø45.7 @ z=22.8  (7.1 + 11.4 axial, DETAIL A)
web = revolve_pts([
    (R_BORE, Z_RECESS), (R_RECESS, Z_RECESS),
    (R_HUB,  Z_WEB2),   (R_BORE,  Z_WEB2),
])

# hub : Ø45.7 tube from z=22.8, closed (solid) from z=35 to z=40
hub = revolve_pts([
    (R_BORE, Z_WEB2), (R_HUB, Z_WEB2),
    (R_HUB, Z_HUB_END), (0.0, Z_HUB_END),
    (0.0, Z_BORE_END), (R_BORE, Z_BORE_END),
])

# shaft : Ø14.3 from hub end face to overall length
shaft = revolve_pts([
    (0.0, Z_HUB_END), (R_SHAFT, Z_HUB_END),
    (R_SHAFT, Z_SHAFT_END), (0.0, Z_SHAFT_END),
])

part = rim + web + hub + shaft

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ radial ribs
# 4 ribs, 17.1 wide, constant 4.3 thickness parallel to the conical web,
# flush with the front face at the rim, ending flat on the hub Ø45.7.
rib_pts = [
    (R_HUB,    Z_WEB2 - RIB_THK),   # (22.85, 18.50) inner end, front
    (R_RECESS, 0.0),                # (35.70,  0.00) front face at rim
    (R_FLANGE, 0.0),                # (40.00,  0.00) rim front outer
    (R_FLANGE, Z_RECESS),           # (40.00,  4.30) rim back outer
    (R_RECESS, Z_RECESS),           # (35.70,  4.30) cone top
    (R_HUB,    Z_WEB2),             # (22.85, 22.80) inner end, back
]
rib = extrude(Plane.XZ * Polygon(*rib_pts, align=None),
              amount=RIB_W / 2.0, both=True)

for i in range(1, RIB_N):                 # 0°, 90°, 180°, 270°
    part += Rot(Z=i * 90.0) * rib

part = part.clean()
